$comment: Machine-checked security policy for the desktop shell. src-tauri/tauri.conf.json and src-tauri/capabilities/default.json must match this file exactly; scripts/check-security-policy.mjs fails when a CSP directive or permission changes without a documented reason. The human-readable companion is docs/security-policy.md.

freezePrototype.reason: Evaluated in phase 2 and kept off. Object.freeze(Object.prototype) makes every inherited built-in non-writable, and pdf-lib assigns PDFHeader.prototype.toString, so the page throws `Cannot assign to read only property 'toString' of object '#<PDFHeader>'` while loading. Reproduced in Chromium with an init script and in the packaged WebKitGTK smoke test, which never left the boot screen. Revisit only if pdf-lib stops overriding Object.prototype members.

default-src.reason: Every asset is served from the bundled frontend; the app has no network dependency.

img-src.reason: Embedded PNG/JPEG assets are data URLs, and page thumbnails and render canvases use blob URLs.

style-src.reason: Application styles are bundled CSS files. The boot screen uses public/boot.css and all dynamic styling uses the CSSOM, so no inline style attribute or style element is needed.

font-src.reason: Bundled Liberation Sans and the PDF.js standard font data are served locally; some font data is inlined as data URLs.

script-src.reason: 'wasm-unsafe-eval' lets PDF.js decode CCITT/JBIG2 pages and lets Tesseract compile its WASM core. blob: is required because PDF.js wraps its worker module in a blob URL when the tauri: scheme has an opaque origin; workers are created from blob URLs so they inherit this policy.

worker-src.reason: The PDF.js and Tesseract workers are bundled scripts. They are created from blob shims so the document policy applies inside them (F-029).

connect-src.reason: 'self' covers local asset and worker-language fetches; ipc: and http://ipc.localhost are the Tauri IPC transports on the supported platforms. No remote origin is allowed.

object-src.reason: The app never embeds a plugin or object element.

base-uri.reason: base-uri is not covered by default-src; the app uses document-relative URLs only.

frame-src.reason: The app creates no iframe, frame or object; PDF pages are rendered to canvas.

form-action.reason: The app has no form submission; dialogs and settings are handled in-process.

script-src.reason: The Vite dev server injects an inline module bootstrap and HMR client. This source is only present in devCsp and is removed from the production policy.

style-src.reason: Vite injects stylesheets as style elements during development. Production CSS is emitted as files, so the shipped policy keeps style-src 'self'.

connect-src.reason: Vite HMR websocket and module requests during development only. The production policy has no localhost or ws: origin.

csp.authoritativeProductionPolicy: src-tauri/tauri.conf.json app.security.csp is the only page policy in the shipped desktop app; the shell adds it as an HTML response header. index.html deliberately carries no meta CSP. The Vite dev server injects app.security.devCsp as a meta tag for the browser fallback only (vite.config.ts developmentCsp).
csp.workerPolicy: PDF.js (src/pdf/pdfRenderer.ts) and Tesseract (src/search/ocr.ts) create their workers from blob shims, so the worker global inherits the document policy and cannot fetch or import a remote URL. A same-origin URL worker would run without a policy in the Tauri webview (F-029).

capabilities.core:event:default: Window resize, close-requested, drag-and-drop and launch-path delivery all use the event API (listen/unlisten).
capabilities.core:window:allow-destroy: The title-bar close and File -> Quit call destroy() after the unsaved-changes prompt.
capabilities.core:window:allow-internal-toggle-maximi: Double-clicking the custom title bar drags/maximizes through the data-tauri-drag-region script.
capabilities.core:window:allow-is-maximized: The title bar chooses the maximize or restore glyph and label.
capabilities.core:window:allow-start-dragging: Dragging the custom title bar starts a native window move.
capabilities.dialog:allow-open: File -> Open project/drawing and Relink use the native open dialog.
capabilities.dialog:allow-save: Save, Save As, export targets and package output use the native save dialog.

testOnlyCommands: smoke_test_dir and finish_smoke_test live in src-tauri/src/smoke.rs and are compiled with #[cfg(debug_assertions)] only. A normal release build has no handler that can exit the app (F-037).
